primary_sources.title: Action understanding as inverse planning
primary_sources.finding: Goal inference is naturally modeled as posterior inference over candidate latent goals given observed behavior under an explicit approximately-rational generative model; priors and goal representation materially affect posterior judgments.

primary_sources.title: Probabilistic Plan Recognition Using Off-the-Shelf Classical Planners
primary_sources.finding: Probabilistic goal recognition can compare candidate goals via observation-constrained versus unconstrained plan cost, but the published formulation assumes deterministic effects and complete initial-state information; this assumption does not transfer wholesale to WP804 partial-observation evaluation.

primary_sources.title: Legibility and Predictability of Robot Motion
primary_sources.finding: Inference from trajectories to goals (legibility) is directionally distinct from predicting trajectories given a goal (predictability); benchmark design must not conflate goal-inference quality with next-action/world-model predictability.

primary_sources.title: Planning and acting in partially observable stochastic domains
primary_sources.finding: Partial observability requires reasoning from observation history/belief rather than evaluator latent state; hidden state is not legitimate policy input merely because the evaluator has it.

primary_sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
primary_sources.finding: Abstention must be evaluated jointly with coverage/risk; otherwise a system can improve apparent accuracy by declining difficult cases.

primary_sources.title: Leveraging Procedural Generation to Benchmark Reinforcement Learning
primary_sources.finding: Generalization claims require evaluation on diverse held-out environment instances/distributions rather than reuse of the same small set of situations.

source_code_pins.finding: The code exposes an explicit partially-observable agent view while also providing fully-observable wrappers, a concrete demonstration that observation and evaluator/world-state channels must remain capability-separated.
Pinned external benchmark implementation associated with procedural held-out generalization; used as a split/generalization design reference only, not as F2 evidence.

distilled_wp804_invariants: GOAL_POSTERIOR_NOT_GOAL_AUTHORITY: benchmark inference is a hypothesis distribution/label prediction only and never adopts a GoalContract.

PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_ONLY: tested policy may use public ObservationView history, public action history if declared, and immutable public candidate-goal descriptors; evaluator hidden state/labels remain inaccessible until after output sealing.

AMBIGUITY_IS_VALID: if multiple candidate goals are observationally equivalent under the public evidence, UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN is correct behavior and must not be auto-penalized as an ordinary wrong label.
ABSTENTION_NEEDS_COVERAGE: report selective risk plus coverage, not accuracy alone.
INFERENCE_NEQ_PREDICTION: goal legibility/inference and trajectory/world prediction are different benchmark questions and should remain separate WP804 versus WP803 measures.
PRIORS_ARE_PART_OF_THE_CONTRACT: candidate-goal prior or baseline assumptions must be explicit, immutable and scored separately from evidence likelihood.

HOLDOUT_BY_CAUSAL_FAMILY: split by fixture/goal-layout or generative family as well as episode/run identity when feasible; random episodes from the same latent template are insufficient evidence of transfer.
EVALUATE_AFTER_SEAL: evaluator labels and hidden trajectory consequences are read only after the policy output is sealed and identity-bound.
ASSUMPTION_GUARD: classical-plan-recognition mechanisms that require complete initial state/deterministic effects may serve as baselines only when those assumptions are explicitly satisfied.
candidate_metrics: top-1 goal agreement on answered cases
Brier or log score if the benchmark exposes normalized candidate-goal probabilities
UNKNOWN correctness on deliberately non-identifiable cases
baseline-relative delta against uniform-prior, shortest-public-path or declared cost-difference baselines
counterhypotheses: A simpler deterministic evidence-count or shortest-public-path baseline may match inverse-planning performance in the tiny MicroWorld; if so, a Bayesian inverse-planning implementation would be needless complexity.

UNKNOWN handling may dominate benchmark outcomes if too many fixtures are non-identifiable; therefore coverage and identifiable-subset reporting are necessary to prevent trivial abstention from looking strong.
Held-out episodes alone may not test generalization if they reuse the same latent goal/layout family; family-level separation is the stronger falsifier.

recommended_next_stage.objective: Map these source-derived invariants onto WP804 exact interfaces/tests without implementing or mutating WP804-owned paths; especially derive fail-closed leakage tests, observational-equivalence UNKNOWN fixtures, explicit priors/baselines and selective-risk metrics.
